featured_reviews.review_text: Attended Rohan Gujral's Show here. Costed us 500 + convenience fee on Book my show. Then they have this sofa or bed sort of kept outside on stairs.. When we went smokers were sitting there. For a minute, we decided to leave but then this guy came from top and told us to come exact on time for the show. We were merely 15 mins ahead but anyways went down to grab some drinks and snacks. There is no cafe or fancy restaurant around except for the one on top of which this place is there. Anyways then we went back on time, the room is really small for shows. featured_reviews.review_text: The Khar Comedy Club, this is the 4th KCC newly opened, easy to travel , to enter you need to enter from main entrance, the building is currently under construction so be carefull, the space is small but that's what make such Comedy shows briliant, around 80-100 people capacity, The vibe is good, chairs are kind of comfortable, went here for Biswas show 'Trying new jox', Enjoyed alot, The food stalls are outside of premises juices, chat and sandwich option available

featured_reviews.name: MANALI GHOSAL
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been following Khar Comedy Club since its very first days — when shows were happening in a tiny room inside a rented flat for just a few hours. Watching them grow from that humble, makeshift setup to now having their own beautifully designed 100-seater club has been nothing short of inspiring. The interiors are modern, classy, and built with performers and audience comfort in mind. Sound, lights, seating  everything feels professionally set and thoughtfully done.

The team is genuinely lovely, welcoming, and extremely passionate about comedy. They consistently bring the best comedians in the circuit, and still manage to keep ticket prices affordable and audience-friendly, which says a lot about their intent. Every show feels curated, cozy, and full of laughs  exactly what a comedy space should be.
So proud to see how far they’ve come.
If you’re looking for a night of great comedy with an even greater vibe — Khar Comedy Club is your spot!

name: Mandar Bhide - Stand Up Comedian
description:
Mandar Bhide is India's only comedian who performs in 4 languages - English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi. He has performed in all major cities in India & has done many shows abroad. He is the only Marathi comedian to have 3 different 1 hour solo shows, in addition to a show called - The Bhide & Bendre Show, which is a take on current social issues. He also stars in the podcast - Headphone Laav Re & features in multiple stand up videos & sketch comedies online. He has played a cameo in the popular Marathi webseries - Pandu & has acted in a TVC for OYO Rooms.

He has done more than 600 shows till date. His observational jokes work very well with people across age groups. He also does a lot of corporate shows, college shows & private shows.

Overall, a great show but the management and seating experience could definitely be better.

The spaces where events commence are spacious and we'll ventilated. The staff is so helpful and sweet. Do attend 'Mystery Monday' for an unexpectedly fun night 🤩😆🔥. It was a blast.

review_photos.caption: Akshay Mehta the host of Mystery Monday... He is such a witty and funny guy.
The previous Monday 'Open Mic Winner - Jay Reddy' performing the opening act for 'Myster Monday'
And the one and only Pavithra Shetty... Love her ❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Arpita Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Great vibe, comfy seating, and loved watching Pranav Sharma live! 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Jeki Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a terrific evening at Backspace, Lower Parel — the vibe is raw, creative, and full of energy. The acoustics were good, and the mic setup felt solid. The space is cozy — felt a bit tight during popular shows, but that's okay. The staff were friendly and handled the event smoothly.

Would’ve liked just a bit more comfort in seating, but overall a great place for live comedy. Definitely worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: Manish Shingre
featured_reviews.review_text: Amazing place. Wide room setup. The team only arranges for 3 rows in a curved setup. The comedian can easily interact with anyone from the crowd.

featured_reviews.name: Tushar Mohta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Backspace has the vibes of rave parties but once you are in the main hall, you see how great is the environment they have created. Great sense of theme and taste for the place. The only downside is that is on the third floor and stairs are steep.
Better keep the oldies at home.

Akash Mehta is a crazy host and comic. You might get gagged by his gags. A non stop 1 hour comedy roller coaster. It's a sin to not have watched Akash's material. Still awed!

featured_reviews.name: Hemant Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Most pathetic venue ever. They wud cancel standup gigs last moment when u have reached there and wont be even courteous to tell u 2 minutes in advance despite having ur contact details.

Happend twice now, today again on 8th feb they have kept audience uninformed and cancelled the show.
